P1.method: Connected ink components (luma >= 96) per frame; U+0E38 is the settled frame's smallest component, and in entrance frames the smallest component of 0.5–1.6× that area (earlier frames show other units only). Attached when it lies under its base (horizontal overlap >= 0.5) at the settled gap ±6 px; wght/wdth vary during the entrance, so the gap is not exact.
